2610.04915.title: Are We Measuring Scientific Intelligence? Rethinking the Evaluation of AI Scientists
2610.04915.paper_summary: AI agents can now carry out data-driven scientific analyses end to end, and benchmarks assess them by giving an agent a question and a dataset and scoring its final answer against a fixed key. These benchmarks assume that a correct answer was derived from the supplied data, a property we call evidence grounding. However, an agent can also reach the key from prior knowledge or by ruling out the other options, and a score based on a single run cannot tell these cases apart. We show how to test this assumption and find that it often fails. For each question, we build versions of its data files in which the evidence for the answer is left intact, withdrawn or reversed, check each edit with a pre-registered reference statistic, and run the same agent on every version. We then measure evidence-grounded accuracy, which credits a correct answer only if the agent also responds when the evidence is withdrawn and follows it when it is reversed. We evaluate three agent scaffolds and five models on 18 single-cell questions from BAISBench and four synthetic problems from GeneBench-Pro. On the single-cell questions, the Claude agents are 95% accurate and answer 83% correctly without any data, but their evidence-grounded accuracy is only 41%. Hiding gene names raises the share of runs that follow reversed evidence from 58% to 93% on ten gene tasks, suggesting that prior knowledge competes with the supplied data. The benchmark score and LLM judges can also reward answers that ignore the changed evidence. Measuring scientific intelligence rather than recall therefore requires checking whether answers follow the evidence and whether scores reward them for it.
2610.04915.paper_summary_zh: AI 代理現在可以端到端地進行數據驅動的科學分析，基準測試通過給代理一個問題和一個數據集來評估它，並根據固定的答案鍵對其最終答案進行打分。這些基準假設正確答案是從提供的數據中推導出來的，這一特性我們稱之為證據基礎。然而，代理也可以通過先前的知識或排除其他選項來達到答案鍵，基於單次運行的分數無法區分這些情況。我們展示了如何測試這一假設，並發現它經常失效。對於每個問題，我們構建其數據文件的版本，其中答案的證據保持不變、撤回或反轉，並用預先註冊的參考統計檢查每次編輯，並在每個版本上運行相同的代理。然後，我們測量證據基礎的準確性，只有當代理在證據被撤回時也作出反應並在證據被反轉時遵循它時，才給予正確答案的信用。我們在來自 BAISBench 的 18 個單細胞問題和來自 GeneBench-Pro 的四個合成問題上評估了三個代理框架和五個模型。在單細胞問題中，Claude 代理的準確率為 95%，在沒有任何數據的情況下正確回答 83%，但其證據基礎的準確率僅為 41%。隱藏基因名稱將遵循反轉證據的運行比例從 58% 提高到 93% 在十個基因任務上，這表明先前的知識與提供的數據存在競爭。基準分數和 LLM 評委也可能獎勵忽略變更證據的答案。因此，測量科學智能而非回憶需要檢查答案是否遵循證據，以及分數是否為此獎勵它們。
